commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-resolution source sheet for a cozy farming game's medicinal herb sprites, to be downsampled later into 16x32 crop sprites and 16x16 inventory icons.
Create ONE wide transparent PNG, aspect ratio 2:1, ideally 2048x1024. EXACTLY FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, eight isolated assets, one per square cell, with generous transparent padding. No cell borders.
Style: exquisitely drawn charming 2D farming RPG botanical game assets. Softly rounded chunky readable forms, rich saturated color blocks, warm upper-left highlights, colorful deep shadows, clean confident dark colored outlines and simplified large leaves. Orthographic three-quarter view from slightly above, like Stardew Valley crops, no isometric diamonds. Paint beautiful coherent high-resolution source art FIRST; do not fake an enlarged low-resolution grid. Shape design must survive reduction. No microscopic detail, no stipple, no loose brush noise.
Cell order EXACTLY:
TOP ROW col1: tiny split seed with two tiny green nubs, no soil.
TOP ROW col2: small two-leaf sprout with a short stem.
TOP ROW col3: juvenile plant with four to six leaves, no mature produce.
TOP ROW col4: almost mature plant, small closed buds or folded new leaves.
BOTTOM ROW col1: FULL mature harvestable plant, beautiful lush recognizable silhouette, three prominent focal forms and secondary foliage. This is the hero.
BOTTOM ROW col2: SAME plant after harvesting, lower leaves and short branched stems retained, remove mature produce, visibly different but alive.
BOTTOM ROW col3: separate compact HARVESTED SPRIG inventory icon with its signature leaves/produce, no roots, no tie.
BOTTOM ROW col4: a squat folded warm cream/kraft paper seed envelope with a large simple species emblem, no writing.
Use the SAME full growth scale in all plant cells: seed occupies about 12% of its cell, sprout 25%, juvenile 45%, budding 65%, mature 78%, picked 60%. Bottom aligned at 88% cell height, horizontally centered. Harvest icon and seed packet occupy about 75% of their own cells. Every asset is fully contained in its cell and disconnected from all others.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, all empty areas completely transparent. NO floor, soil, shadow patches, pot, labels, letters, numbers, watermark, scenery or checkered pattern. Exactly 8 assets.

species.name: glass-dewberry
species.prompt: Species GLASS DEWBERRY: a lush low rounded bush of deep teal oval leaves. Mature plant has exactly three oversized jewel-like sky-blue glass berries of different sizes on short arching stems. Deep cobalt lower-right shading, bright cyan centers, a bold warm ivory reflection and secondary turquoise rim reflection. Berries must look round, juicy and glassy, dominating the plant rather than tiny dots. Buds are little cyan beads. Harvest icon: three blue berries on a short curved sprig with two teal leaves. Packet emblem: one big blue glass berry and teal leaf.

species.name: moonvelvet
species.prompt: Species MOONVELVET: velvety sage leaves with pale silver-green rims and gently curved stems. Mature plant has three LARGE drooping lavender bell flowers, lilac upper bells and dark plum open throats, scalloped creamy lavender rims. They are recognizable hanging bells with flared rims, not round berries or straight lavender spikes. A graceful asymmetrical arch, broad plush oval leaves at the base. Buds are elongated lavender teardrops. Harvest icon: a curved short sprig with two large lavender hanging bells and a sage leaf. Packet emblem: one purple hanging bell.

species.name: amber-heartleaf
species.prompt: Species AMBER HEARTLEAF: a warm golden leafy medicinal bush on thin reddish chestnut branching stems, with three prominent TRUE HEART-SHAPED amber-gold leaves, rounded upper lobes and pointed bottoms, secondary olive-gold basal leaves. Honey yellow faces, glowing pale yellow upper-left edges, deep burnt orange shadows, simple russet central veins. Mature foliage must have clear heart silhouettes, absolutely no flowers, fruit or berries. Young leaves are green becoming warm yellow-orange; budding stage has folded amber heart leaves. Picked plant retains red stems and small olive basal leaves with the large golden harvest leaves removed. Harvest icon: two large golden heart leaves and a small third leaf on a curved red stem. Packet emblem: one amber heart leaf.

species.name: silver-seamleaf
species.prompt: Species SILVER SEAMLEAF: an elegant low fan of broad pointed lance-shaped SILVERY MINT leaves with a creamy central stitched vein, cool sage shadows and pale silver upper-left highlights. Make the vein readable as a thick bright midrib with a few short alternating stitches. Mature plant is a lush fan of five to seven pointed leaves and ONE small ivory five-petal flower with a gold center on a short curved stem. Leaves are the focal feature, not the flower. Budding stage has folded silver-mint leaves and a closed ivory bud. Picked stage retains a smaller basal fan and clipped flower stem. Harvest icon: three broad pointed silver-mint leaves with pale midribs plus one tiny ivory blossom. Packet emblem: a pointed silver-mint leaf.
